findings.description: The Wikimedia TimedText pages for Nomiku with VO and Nomiku without VO display the same 11 English cues, including the final cue 00:01:20–00:01:24.
findings.implication: The no-VO file's subtitle last cue extends beyond its ~79-second media duration. This proves that the TimedText cannot be assumed to be precisely aligned across both file variants; it does NOT prove that the VO version's captions are wrong. Require actual VO speech-to-cue audit before burning captions.

findings.description: VO media file is declared own work by Pkwong89 under CC BY 4.0, which permits remix with attribution. The separate TimedText page is a text contribution; the general Wikimedia Commons text license is CC BY-SA, and specific subtitle authorship, license obligations and voice/music component ownership remain to be independently reviewed.

Existing 0–28s + 65–71.4s (34.4s) draft jumps over 37 seconds of original explanation; audio energy at 71.4s and cue boundaries do not establish narrative continuity or word-level sync. Do not render or mark ready until independent content and mobile framing review.
